7. Consider the following statements: 1. In India, the Advocate-General of a State is appointed by the President of India on the recommendation of the Governor of the concerned State. 2. According to the provisions of the Code of Civil Proc

value: According to Article 165(1) of the Constitution, the Advocate General of a State is appointed by the Governor of the State and not by the President. Therefore, statement 1 is incorrect. Advisory jurisdiction is exclusively granted to the Supreme Court of India under Article 143 of the Constitution.While High Courts do possess original, appellate, and supervisory jurisdictions, these foundational powers are derived primarily from the Constitution of India and historical Letters Patent, rather than the Code of Civil Procedure itself (which strictly regulates civil procedural rules).

60. Which of the following is the main component of cement?

value:
Lime | CaO | 60 - 67 | Provides core strength; controls setting time and soundness.Limestone and silica clay are used as raw materials in the production of cement. When silica clay and limestone are heated together, they melt and react to form “cement clinker”. Gypsum, up to 2–3% by weight, is added to this clinker.
Silica | SiO2 | 17 - 25 | Imparts long-term strength and durability (dicalcium/tricalcium silicates).
Alumina | Al2O3 | 3 - 8 | Provides quick-setting properties; acts as a flux to lower kiln temperatures.
Iron Oxide | Fe2O3 | 0.5 - 6 | Imparts the distinct grey color; adds hardness and aids raw material fusion.
Magnesia | MgO | 0.1 - 4 | Adds strength and color in small amounts; excess causes unsoundness (expansion).
Sulphur Trioxide | SO3 | 1 - 3 | Retards setting time (typically added as gypsum) to maintain workability.
Alkalies | K2O, Na2O | 0.4 - 1.3 | Kept strictly low to prevent efflorescence (white staining) and structural reactions.

111. Consider the following statements with reference to the 2026 Whitley Award (Green Oscar): 1. The 2026 award was presented to Indian conservationist Parveen Shaikh in London. 2. This award has been given to her for the conservation of t

value: On April 29, 2026, Parveen Shaikh was honoured with the 2026 Whitley Award at the Royal Geographical Society in London. The Whitley Awards are often called the “Green Oscars”. Parveen Shaikh is a conservation scientist associated with BNHS. Therefore, statement 1 correct. She received this award for community-based conservation work for the endangered Indian Skimmer. The Indian Skimmer is included in the Endangered category of the IUCN Red List. More than 90% of its global breeding population is found in India, and the Chambal River region is one of its major breeding habitats. Under Parveen Shaikh’s “Guardians of the Skimmer” initiative, local communities were involved as nest guardians, which increased the nest survival rate from 14% to 27%.
